output.reason: An 8-year-old with one night of right ear pain, no reported fever, eating normally and attending school can start with home comfort measures and specified return triggers rather than a required clinician task today.
output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home for now: give age-appropriate pain relief as labelled, keep her upright-ish for sleep, and watch her over the next day or two. One night of ear pain without fever in a child who is eating and at school often settles on its own. Message us or seek same-day care if pain worsens, fever develops, fluid or blood drains from the ear, she becomes drowsy, or there's swelling/redness behind the ear.

output.vitalSigns: No temperature or other vital-sign values reported; whether any measurement was taken is unknown, and fever was denied by report only.
